info.title: Streamix SXAPI v1
info.description: Independent Streamix client protocol with login, current identity, typed file-backed filters/ordering, seasons and bounded revision-current technical inventory, minimal direct-file playback, user flags, session-bound progress private client-reported history bounded original artwork and exact external UTF-8 subtitle delivery. Playback preparation/bytes require initialized and enabled Nimbus; subtitle delivery also requires initialized enabled Nimbus; independent scoped administration sessions and users/roles/policies/libraries summaries are implemented; core administration commands and explicit stored/runtime authority views are implemented; source/task/credential configuration is implemented; bundled plugin management is implemented; transactional metadata/probe/file-work controls and safe operational observations are implemented; independent tenant-bound UHDAdmin service credentials, account reconciliation and safe telemetry projection are implemented; bounded actual processing queue observations and provider worker/reconcile commands with original results are implemented; actual metadata proposed-scope previews and bounded historical technical snapshot observations are implemented; remaining further processing, dynamic extensions/further administration/integrations and legacy restriction enforcement remain incomplete. This contract is not a 0.9.0 completion claim. Malformed typed Path parameters use the stable SXAPI invalid_request JSON envelope; HEAD has no body. The outer native claims injector delegates only the exact /sxapi/v1 namespace to its own required client/admin/service or exact stream-ticket boundary. Cross-domain credentials return401 without a native authentication storage query; current SXAPI authentication storage failures return the private sanitized503 envelope with Retry-After1. Native Drive callback now shares registered-channel authority/durability; other native and ECAL credential acceptance is unchanged. Optional private Nimbus video composition is available through sealed host interfaces: it requires migration164 and an initialized private issuer, keeps original SXAPI profile/login/current-policy controls, and has no signed/provider fallback in remote mode. Private SXAPI subtitle capability defaults to false via supports_sxapi_subtitles; a complete composed issuer may advertise true only with the dedicated bounded whole-file UTF-8/original-format validation and backend path. The old subtitle byte routes remain503 in remote mode; dedicated issuance has no Redis/provider fallback. The real SDK/Node composition, complete text-validation lane and client acceptance remain separate unexecuted gates. Ordinary typed metadata persistence locks the actual READ COMMITTED parent, then rechecks persisted adult evidence and ALL historical adult_origin; domain/typed-owner conflicts roll back rather than returning an adult UUID or silently creating a fallback. NULL/type-less new-file and None inventory remain available; only an actual file-owned unidentified parent may complete its first real typed identity before a final ordinary check. Secondary adult TMDB IDs are retained by the confirmed unapplied171 draft, not granted ordinary access; global same-tuple collisions remain explicit conflicts. Existing adult/unrestricted reads and mixed-origin quarantine remain. Async admission is not completion; final-source PG15/16, migration and server acceptance remain required.

Only exactly one X-SXAPI-Stream-Ticket header is accepted; query credentials, duplicate or comma-combined headers return401. An Authorization header is irrelevant and neither replaces nor invalidates the ticket. Single bytes=start-end/open-end/suffix ranges are supported. ETag is weak and revision-bound; any If-Range requests receive the complete representation with 200. HEAD fetches upstream metadata, returns no body and creates no transfer lease or bandwidth charge. GET uses Nimbus range/cache transport, shared admission and atomic byte ledger, with authorization checks before each buffered batch and every two seconds during a stalled body. A positive result from an earlier batch is never reused to authorize a later batch. After headers, revocation/upstream body errors terminate the body rather than changing its status. Off/absent transport rechecks the original login, session, library, playback policy and exact source after a successful upstream metadata wait, before any size-mismatch or Range-error response. Changed authority takes precedence over a metadata-derived416 and does not publish file Content-Range, Accept-Ranges or ETag; unchanged authorized unsatisfiable ranges retain416 with bytes */size. This is a source correction awaiting final-source PG15/16 evidence, not private Host or client acceptance. This is the legacy/off transport. StreamixUserAgent.name: User-Agent
StreamixUserAgent.description: Optional self-reported RFC9110 product/version and comments; retained at most1024 UTF-8 bytes. First-party: Streamix/version (...) StreamixCore/version; third-party own product plus StreamixKit/version. No credential, username, server address or IP. Never authorization.

StreamixClient.name: X-Streamix-Client
StreamixClient.description: Optional product/version, at most128 bytes; malformed or duplicate values ignored and counted. Client labels are never authorization.

StreamixDeviceId.name: X-Streamix-Device-Id
StreamixDeviceId.description: Optional lowercase canonical nonzero UUID randomly generated once per installation. Not a hardware serial or authenticated device identity. Invalid/duplicate values ignored and counted; never invalidates previous logins.

StreamixDeviceName.name: X-Streamix-Device-Name
StreamixDeviceName.description: Optional percent-encoded UTF-8 user-editable label; decoded limit128 bytes, no control characters. Percent decoding preserves literal plus. Invalid/duplicate/oversized values ignored and counted. Kept only in owner/admin observations; escape for display.

StreamixProtocol.name: X-Streamix-Protocol
StreamixProtocol.description: Optional SXAPI/version. Accepted versions equal capabilities.accepted_client_versions. Missing preserves existing behaviour; unsupported, malformed or duplicated header returns400 client_version_unsupported. Feature availability still requires capabilities.

StreamixPurpose.name: Sec-Purpose
StreamixPurpose.description: Optional Structured Fields list; a top-level prefetch token marks background work, including parameters. Strings/parameter values do not. Invalid value ignored and counted. Browser-generated forbidden Sec- header: do not try to set from browser script. Two independent process-local response-lifetime prefetch slots, immediate429 prefetch_busy with Retry-After:1 when busy; normal playback does not acquire these slots. Original authorization and byte accounting still apply.

StreamixLanguage.name: Accept-Language
StreamixLanguage.description: Optional weighted language preferences, at most16 ranges. Use only actually stored language variants; current catalog keeps its stored default title/overview and existing English genre dictionary, with no per-language translation store. No translation synthesized or external lookup. Error codes are stable. Current API responses are private/no-store; future cacheable localized responses must Vary on Accept-Language.

StreamixTraceparent.name: traceparent
StreamixTraceparent.description: Optional W3C Trace Context. Lowercase hex; nonzero32hex trace-id and16hex parent-id; version00 exactly55 bytes, ff invalid; future version known prefix parsed per W3C. Invalid/duplicate ignored and counted. Valid trace-id reaches sampled durable request_log and tracing span; raw parent/header values and credentials are not recorded. X-Request-Id is the independent server request identifier.
